docs.title: Documents
docs.draftHelp: These are drafts for you to review. Once you are happy, ask for the PDF in the reply box below and it will compile them.
docs.byName: Found by matching the company and role in the file names.

launch.tagline: A calm place for the whole job hunt.

home.title: Pipeline
home.needFolder: Start by choosing your ai-job-search folder.
home.needEngine: Your folder is ready. Next, connect your AI engine.
home.ready: Your folder and AI engine are ready.

settings.title: Settings
settings.askEveryChange: Ask before every file change in your folder
settings.askEveryOff: Off: commands can change files inside your folder without asking. Your folder's protected files (its code and settings) still ask.
settings.askEveryOn: On: every file change shows an Allow once / Deny card.
settings.alwaysRefused: Always refused, whatever this switch says: changes outside your folder, uploading to GitHub, deleting folders and admin commands.
settings.askWeb: Ask before it looks things up online
settings.askWebOff: Off: commands can read job pages and search the web without asking. Your folder's rules on robots.txt and site terms still apply.
settings.autoApproveOn: On: commands run without asking. It still refuses anything outside your folder, git push, deleting folders, admin commands and your Indeed resume. The two switches below are not used while this is on.
settings.autoApproveOff: Off: you see an Allow once / Deny card for what the AI wants to run.
settings.askWebOn: On: every web page and web search shows an Allow once / Deny card.
settings.slotsHint: How many postings each source may add when you press Find new jobs. Whole numbers, 0 or more; 0 skips that source.
settings.slotsInvalid: Use a whole number, 0 or more.
settings.runSetupNote: Opens the first-run steps again: AI engine, computer check, folder and profile. Nothing is reset.

workspace.title: Your folder
workspace.intro: Pick the copy of ai-job-search already on this computer. Your files stay there; nothing is uploaded to GitHub or the cloud.
workspace.rejected: This folder doesn't look like ai-job-search, so it wasn't saved.

problem.missing: The folder can't be found. It may have been moved or renamed.
problem.notFolder: This is a file, not a folder.

ok.noProfile: Your profile isn't filled in yet

cc.name: Your Claude Code
cc.privacy: Uses the Claude Code already signed in on this computer. Your files are sent only as a task needs them, under your own Claude plan.

key.name: Anthropic API key
key.privacy: Stored encrypted on this computer. Tasks are billed to this key.

state.outdated: Version {{version}} is too old. {{min}} or newer is needed.
state.notFound: Claude Code isn't installed on this computer
state.error: Claude Code didn't answer. Try Check again.

help.signedOut: Sign in opens Claude Code's own sign-in in a terminal window. When it says you're signed in, come back and press Check again.
help.notFound: Install Claude Code from Anthropic's website, sign in once, then press Check again.
help.outdated: Update Claude Code (run "claude update" in a terminal), then press Check again. Older versions trust compromised security certificates.

addJob.title: Add a job
addJob.label: Paste a job link or the posting text
addJob.note: We check how well it fits you first. Nothing is drafted until you say so.

refused.busy: Another job is still running. Wait for it to finish, or stop it first.
refused.noWorkspace: Choose your ai-job-search folder in Settings first.
refused.badInput: That can't be sent. Paste a link or the posting text.

job.stopNote: Stopping keeps any files already written.
job.stoppedOnClose: The app closed while this was running. Reply below to continue where it stopped.
job.removeNote: Removes it from this app only. Your files and tracker stay as they are.

title.command: It wants to run a command
title.write: It wants to change a file
title.web: It wants to look something up online
title.other: It wants to use a tool

ask.hint: Nothing happens until you choose. Allow once lets this one action through.

deny.indeedResume: Reading your résumé on Indeed. No command may read it:
deny.indeedCompany: Looking up company details on Indeed. Only allowed while drafting an application:

fit.title: How well it fits
fit.notNowNote: Kept as is. You can still reply below to prepare it later.

row.readOnly: From your tracker (job_search_tracker.csv). This app only reads it; the job-search commands keep it up to date.

error.unreadable: Your tracker couldn't be read. It may be open in another program.
error.tooLarge: Your tracker is too large to show here.
error.noHeader: Your tracker's first line doesn't have the usual column names, so it can't be shown.

outcome.title: Update status
outcome.notePlaceholder: For example: interview with the hiring manager next Tuesday
outcome.how: Recorded straight away in your tracker, no AI needed. If it can't be matched to a row, your AI engine will sort it out and the card moves when it's done.

search.never: No search yet. Find new jobs searches your job sites, then ranks what it finds against your profile.
search.summary: {{ranked}} ranked jobs to look at · {{waiting}} found but not ranked yet.

fresh.title: Start fresh
fresh.body: Clears this list so you can search again on a clean screen. Jobs on your board stay. Nothing in your folder is deleted, and cleared jobs can be brought back.

clear.ask: Empty this list of {{count}} results? Jobs on your board stay.

error.unreadable: The list of found jobs couldn't be read.
error.tooLarge: The list of found jobs is too large to show here.

missing.title: Missing details
missing.intro_other: {{count}} postings lack details that help you decide, least complete first. Close the ones you don't want; they won't come back.
missing.intro_one: 1 posting lacks details that help you decide. Close it if you don't want it; it won't come back.

freed.ask: The freed search slots are open. What next?
freed.share: Give the slots to the other sources
freed.indeedNote: Indeed can't load more results. Searching it again repeats the search and may bring different postings, or none.
freed.noTargets: No other source has slots to give.

health.title: This computer
health.intro: The job-search commands use a few free tools. Shortlist checks for them; it never installs anything. A missing tool doesn't stop you, but the commands that need it may fail or skip a step.

use.python: runs the tracker, status updates and PDF checks
use.git: needed to set up a new job-search folder
use.lualatex: turns your CV into a PDF
use.xelatex: turns your cover letter into a PDF
use.pypdf: checks that recruiters' systems can read your PDFs
use.poppler: checks your CV's layout page by page

problem.old: Version {{version}} is too old. {{min}} or newer is needed.
problem.needsPython: Can't be checked until Python is installed.
problem.noBbox: Found, but this version can't measure page layout, so the layout check will be skipped.
problem.brokenBbox: Version {{version}} has a bug that stops the layout check. Update to 26.05 or newer.
problem.noPdftoppm: Found, but pdftoppm is missing, so CV page previews will be skipped.

reply.label: Your reply
reply.placeholder: Write your answer in your own words.
reply.truth: Only true details: the AI won't add anything you don't tell it.
reply.busy: Another job is running. You can send this once it finishes.

welcome.title: Your job search, on your computer.
welcome.lead: {{name}} is a calm front-end for your ai-job-search folder. Your profile, tracker and applications stay in that folder. The AI engine you connect reads only what a task needs.
welcome.steps: Setup takes about five minutes: connect the AI, check this computer, choose your folder and build your profile.

dataItems.noAccount: No account, no usage data, no network port. The app's screens can't reach the internet.
dataItems.engine: The AI engine you connect sends what a task needs, such as a job posting and the parts of your profile it is matching.
dataItems.files: {{name}} never writes your job-search files itself (apart from copying the framework if you set up a new folder). The job-search commands do, and anything unusual asks you first.
dataItems.updates: {{name}} checks once a day whether a newer version exists. You can turn that off in Settings.

connect.title: Connect the AI
connect.lead: {{name}} runs your job-search commands on an AI engine. You can switch later in Settings without losing anything.

check.title: Check this computer
check.lead: The job-search commands use a few free tools. Nothing is installed here; if something is missing you can still continue and fix it later in Settings.

folder.title: Your job-search folder
folder.lead: Everything lives in one folder on this computer: your profile, tracker, CVs and letters. Nothing is uploaded to GitHub or the cloud.
folder.existingNote: You already have a copy of ai-job-search on this computer.
folder.newNote: A fresh copy of the job-search framework in an empty folder you pick.
folder.gitMissing: This needs Git, which isn't on this computer yet.
folder.gitOld: This needs a newer Git (2.50.1 or newer).
folder.looksRight: This looks like ai-job-search: the job-search commands and CLAUDE.md are here.
folder.notRight: This folder doesn't look like ai-job-search. Choose the folder that has CLAUDE.md and the .claude folder in it.
folder.readOnly: {{name}} only reads this folder. The job-search commands write to it when you run them.
folder.where: Where are you looking for work?

region.uaeNote: The UAE edition: UAE job sites, salary packages with allowances, visa and notice-period guidance.
region.elsewhereNote: The original ai-job-search, which works for any country.

folder.notEmpty: This folder isn't empty. Pick an empty folder, so nothing of yours is overwritten.
folder.needBoth: Choose where you're looking and an empty folder to continue.

step.empty: Checked the folder is still empty
step.copy: Copying the job-search framework (the version tested with this {{name}})
step.push: Turning off uploads to GitHub for this folder

folder.ready: Your folder is ready. Uploads to GitHub are turned off for it.

problem.notEmpty: The folder isn't empty any more. Pick an empty folder.
problem.noGit: Git isn't on this computer, so the copy can't start.
problem.oldGit: Your Git is too old for a safe copy. Update it to 2.50.1 or newer, then try again.
problem.cloneFailed: The copy stopped. Check your internet connection and try again.
problem.pinFailed: The copy finished, but it couldn't be set to the tested version.
problem.checkFailed: The copy finished, but the folder doesn't look like ai-job-search.

folder.partial: Some files were copied before it stopped, so the folder isn't empty now. Nothing was deleted: empty it yourself, or choose another empty folder.

profile.title: Build your profile
profile.lead: The AI writes your profile from what you give it: experience, skills, goals and the jobs you want. It never invents experience. You can change any part later.
profile.already: Your folder already has a profile
profile.alreadyNote: Nothing to do here. You can update it any time.
profile.howTitle: The AI will ask how you'd like to start

how.importNote: your CV, LinkedIn export, certificates and old applications. Quickest.
how.pasteNote: paste the text, then answer a few follow-up questions.
how.interviewNote: answer questions section by section. Good if you're starting from scratch.

profile.leaveNote: You can leave this step; the conversation stays in the job list and waits for your answers.

done.title: You're set up.
done.lead: Next, find jobs that fit your profile, or add one you've already seen.
done.computerFix_one: This computer: {{count}} thing to fix later
done.computerFix_other: This computer: {{count}} things to fix later
done.again: You can run this setup again any time from Settings.
